rules.name: Mass File Encryption Pattern
rules.description: Detection rules for ransomware indicators: encryption patterns, C2 behavior, lateral movement preceding ransomware deployment
rules.query: union SecurityEvent, CommonSecurityLog | where (CommandLine contains "vssadmin delete" or CommandLine contains "wbadmin delete" or Message contains ".encrypted" or Message contains ".locked") | summarize count(), make_set(Computer) by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
